title: With Whom, and With What
label: ch:mr-with
canDo: I can say who I am with, who I am speaking to and what I am doing something with, choosing between three endings English collapses into one, and I can put a pronoun in front of any of them.

payoff.summary: Complete MR-R45-with and put all three endings on mitra, saying for each one whether it takes a companion, a partner in the act, or a tool.
payoff.note: The pronoun's oblique is in this chapter rather than with the noun's, because it is only visible once there is a postposition to put it in front of.
